key_insight: DEScover uses four LLM agents to discover physically interpretable DES subgrid length scales from the idea of measuring grid width normal to the local vortex axis.
engineering_relevance: The framework could accelerate turbulence-model development while improving DES accuracy relative to the standard maximum-cell-size length scale.
method: Infer local vortex axes using candidate vortex-identification methods.
Use four agents to propose, review, implement, and evaluate length-scale formulations.
Generate CFD simulation scripts to test candidate closures.
evidence_signal: Across flat-plate, backward-facing-step, free-shear-layer, and iced-airfoil tests, the best candidate consistently outperformed the standard length scale and matched or slightly exceeded an expert-designed shear-layer-adapted scale.
watch_item: The roughly 25-minute average discovery time excludes CFD simulations, and generalization beyond the four tested flows remains unestablished.
paper_title: Automated Discovery of Physically Interpretable Subgrid Length Scales for Detached Eddy Simulation via Agentic AI
